channel.title: Reserve Bank of Australia - Monetary Policy Mirror

item.title: RBA monetary policy statement: cash rate decision
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia board met to review the cash rate target and monetary policy stance. The board considered inflation trends, labour market conditions and domestic economic activity before deciding on the cash rate. Members weighed the risk of persistent inflation against the slowdown in household consumption. The decision on the cash rate reflects the balance of these risks, and the board signalled that future monetary policy will remain data dependent.
